svg.title: Option C: Dedicated Analysis workspace
svg.desc: Editable phone analysis prototype. All games, plans and numbers are invented examples. Static design, not a deployed app.

g.text: Open a focused workspace with a compact board, report and plan details.
STATIC PROTOTYPE · INVENTED EXAMPLE DATA · 390px main view / 320px state panels
Low · depth 8 · up to 0.05 s / position
Choose a saved game or current line.
First depth or time bound stops search.
Adjacent ? opens a bounded help popover.
Setup → choose limits → run → saved report
A failed save keeps the result available for retry.
Changing the game cancels obsolete work.
Existing saved work stays visible after failure.
